verdict.rationale: Gemini Apps explicitly support 'scheduling recurring actions' so Gemini becomes part of daily/weekly/monthly routines (e.g., daily news digest, daily brief) — this is a documented autonomous background automation feature, further enabled by Gemini's ability to connect to and take actions in other apps (Gmail, Calendar, etc.) as part of those scheduled actions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the scheduling feature's reliability, and detail on more complex/conditional (non-time-based) automation triggers beyond simple recurring schedules.
